title: Regulation, Demand Shocks, and Renter Cost Burdens, 2013-2024: Data and Code
description:
Metro-by-year panel (2013–2024, excluding 2020) and replication code in R and Python for a study of whether restrictive land-use regulation amplified the effects of employment shocks and remote-work exposure on renter cost burdens, rents and permitting across U.S. metropolitan areas.

Contents: the analysis panel and codebook; source data from the American Community Survey, Building Permits Survey, Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages, CPI and OMB metropolitan delineations; metro averages of the Wharton Residential Land Use Regulatory Index 2018 and the NZLUD Zoning Restrictiveness Index; R and Python code that rebuilds the panel and reproduces every table and figure; and an interactive website.
